MWI.note: Mentions verification of IDs at centres but not an electronic service.

facts.fact: Malawi's election law (section 12) requires the electoral commission to accept a national ID or an NRB proof-of-registration notification as the sole identification for voter registration, and NRB staff verify IDs at centres, per the Nation.

MWI.note: No coverage count or share given.
Nothing on who operates or owns the system.
ID accepted as proof for voter registration; no register keyed on the number is stated.

facts.fact: The National Registration Bureau captures biometric registration of people without IDs at voter centres and issues unique numbers approved in Lilongwe, per the Nation in November 2024.
